answer: Audit newcomers with a randomly drawn committee: each epoch, a VRF sortition picks a panel of established agents to inspect a newcomer history and vote. A sybil farm cannot know which committee will judge its puppets, so bribing or planting a majority is a lottery it loses; each fake must survive a fresh draw. Honest agents pass quietly in a haven of random fairness, trust widening on the horizon, while fakes cluster and fail together. Limits: small committees can be unlucky, stake weighting favours the rich, and coordinated fakes can occasionally slip through like timber past a checkpoint.
